waves.title: Waves
waves.subtitle: Delivery waves of this project: which share of each solution lands in which wave, and in what order.
waves.field.name: Name
waves.codeHelp: A short code, e.g. W1 or Wave 2.
waves.nameHelp: What this wave delivers, e.g. Finance + Procurement.
waves.datesHelp: Optional. The order is set by position, not by dates.
waves.empty: No waves yet. Add the first wave to start planning delivery.
waves.retireBody: Retire only a wave created in error; a wave normally ends through its status. A wave that solutions are split into cannot be retired.
waves.restored: Wave {code} restored at the end of the order
waves.stale: Someone else changed the waves. The list has been reloaded; try again.
waves.plan.headline: Effort in this plan
waves.plan.headlineNote: The project's effort headline: every wave, plus what is in no wave yet, plus requirements with no solution.
waves.plan.unrated: {n} function requirements are not rated yet and carry no days.
waves.plan.unrated_one: 1 function requirement is not rated yet and carries no days.
waves.plan.unphasedNote: Solutions with no wave split. Split them on the solution's page.
waves.plan.unassignedNote: Rated function requirements that belong to no solution, so no wave can hold them.
waves.plan.noSolutions: No solution is split into this wave.
waves.warn.PREREQ_LATER: {sol} needs {pre}, which is planned in a later wave.
waves.warn.PREREQ_SAME_WAVE: {sol} needs {pre}, which is planned in the same wave.
waves.warn.PREREQ_UNSCHEDULED: {sol} needs {pre}, which is in no wave yet.
waves.warn.REJECTED_WITH_SPLIT: {sol} is rejected but still split into waves; its effort is left out of the plan.
waves.split.title: Waves
waves.split.help: The share of this solution's effort that lands in each wave. The shares total exactly 100 %, or leave the solution in no wave.
waves.split.stale: Someone else changed this split. It has been reloaded: check it, then edit again.
waves.split.noWaves: This project has no waves yet. Add them under Waves.
waves.split.cancelledHint: A cancelled wave can keep or lower its share; it takes no new effort.
waves.deps.title: Depends on
waves.deps.help: Solutions that must be delivered before this one. A loop of dependencies is refused.
waves.deps.pick: Add a solution it depends on
